content:
We at Google DeepMind are pleased to announce the release of the Formal conjectures repo on GitHub:

https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures

It is dedicated to formalising the statements of conjectures, and intends to aid in clarifying their meaning, serve as a benchmark for automated theorem provers, and encourage the expansion of mathlib by identifying needed definitions.

Contributions are more than welcome – from adding your favourite conjecture, to improving existing ones! As formalising statements without proof can be tricky, feedback and PRs to fix misformalisations are especially appreciated. We hope this to be the seed to a much richer dataset of formalised conjectures.

See the README for more info.

Discussion thread here: #general > Discussion: Formal Conjectures

Currently many of the conjectures come from erdosproblems.com; we would like to thank @Thomas Bloom for this wonderful resource and answering our questions on some of those conjectures.

We'd also like to thank @Johan Commelin, @Kevin Buzzard, @Oliver Nash, @Bhavik Mehta, @Floris van Doorn, @Jason Rute for some early feedback on this release, and of course the mathlib community for building the foundations that make such a repository possible!

The authors of the current set of formalisations include @Moritz Firsching , @Paul Lezeau , @Salvatore Mercuri , @Eric Wieser , @Calle Sönne @Mirek Olšák , @Miklós Z. Horváth , and @Thomas Hubert
